title: Activity counter entry (AD-4 Criterion)
description: One entry of activity_counters.json. The check is one of the four counting check types from check.schema.json. low < high are the counter's movement thresholds in the check's unit (degrees for angles, shoulder-width ratios for pointAbove margin and distanceBelow ratio) and override the check's deg/ratio/margin while counting. angleAbove/pointAbove: a rep starts when the value rises above high and ends when it falls below low. angleBelow/distanceBelow: a rep starts when the value falls below low and ends when it rises above high. kind hold: time accumulates while the value is past the start threshold. target, kind and perSide come verbatim from the source criterion (docs/designs/activity-counter-selection.md). perSide true: left and right are counted separately and each side must reach target; the check must then have side 'either'. The check's deg/ratio/margin must equal the start threshold (high for angleAbove/pointAbove, low for angleBelow/distanceBelow). Angle thresholds are 0..180, distance ratios >= 0, reps targets are whole numbers.
